metadata.description: Illustrative UK supermarket pack-price planning baselines; not real-time observed retailer prices
metadata.region_multipliers: See category_multipliers: these are approximate regional shelf-price scenarios, not live data
metadata.spice_density_assumption: 5ml dried leafy herbs ≈ 1g, needs editorial verification; do not silently assume gram/ml equivalence
metadata.aisle_audit: BasketBoss strict six-aisle catalogue scan; never default food to Household
metadata.price_audit_note: UK retail example prices updated for selected common foods only; remaining entries are estimates or marked needs_review; regional factors illustrative.
metadata.meal_pricing: Scale base ingredient quantity per serving, then ceil ordinary regional packs; pantry staples charged pro-rata. Full-pack checkout remains separate.
metadata.regional_price_note: All regional baselines and US pack overrides are illustrative planning assumptions; no live retailer feed. Unspecified regional packs inherit the common catalog size and category-adjusted price.
metadata.expansion_regional_pack_basis: Illustrative category factors; explicit regional size/price/currency records do not constitute verified retail data.
